name: Time_sync_forts
summary: This EA is a time synchronization utility for the FORTS (Futures and Options on Russian Trading System) market. It synchronizes the local terminal time with the exchange server time to ensure accurate timing for time-sensitive trading operations on the Moscow Exchange derivatives segment.
summary_zh: 这是一个用于FORTS（俄罗斯交易系统期货和期权）市场的时间同步工具EA。它将本地终端时间与交易所服务器时间同步，以确保莫斯科交易所衍生品板块时间敏感交易操作的准确性。
strategy_analysis: 此EA并非交易策略，而是一个时间同步工具。它的核心概念是通过计算本地时间与服务器时间之间的偏移量，实现精确的时间校准。在FORTS市场中，时间同步至关重要，因为该市场的开盘和收盘时间、清算时段等都有严格的时间窗口。该工具不涉及任何入场条件、出场条件或仓位管理逻辑。资金管理方面同样不适用，因为该EA不执行任何交易操作。其主要功能是持续监控并校正时间偏差，为其他依赖精确时间的交易EA提供时间基准服务。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA is not a trading strategy but a time synchronization utility. Its core concept is to calculate the offset between local time and server time to achieve precise time calibration. In the FORTS market, time synchronization is critical because the market has strict time windows for opening, closing, and clearing sessions. The tool does not involve any entry conditions, exit conditions, or position sizing logic. Money management is not applicable since the EA does not execute any trading operations. Its primary function is to continuously monitor and correct time drift, providing a time reference service for other trading EAs that depend on precise timing for order placement and session management.

parameters.name: ServerTimeOffset
parameters.description: 服务器时间偏移量（毫秒）

parameters.name: MaxOffsetThreshold
parameters.description: 最大允许偏移阈值（毫秒）

pros: 为FORTS市场提供精确的时间同步，避免因时间偏差导致的下单失败
可以作为基础工具为其他交易EA提供时间校准服务，提高整体系统可靠性
针对莫斯科交易所衍生品市场的特殊时间要求进行了优化
持续监控时间偏差，及时发现并校正漂移问题
pros_en: Provides precise time synchronization for the FORTS market, avoiding order failures caused by time drift
Serves as a foundational utility offering time calibration for other trading EAs, improving overall system reliability
Optimized for the specific timing requirements of the Moscow Exchange derivatives market
Continuously monitors time deviation, promptly detecting and correcting drift issues
cons: 作为纯工具不产生直接交易收益，仅提供辅助功能
依赖服务器时间的准确性，如果服务器本身时间异常则无法校正
可能占用一定的CPU资源进行频繁的时间同步检测
缺乏异常时间偏差的报警通知机制
cons_en: As a pure utility, it does not generate direct trading profits and only provides auxiliary functionality
Depends on server time accuracy; if the server time itself is abnormal, correction is impossible
May consume some CPU resources due to frequent time synchronization checks
Lacks an alert notification mechanism for abnormal time deviations
improvements: 增加时间偏差超限的报警通知功能（邮件、推送、声音）
添加与交易EA的接口机制，自动将校准时间传递给依赖的EA
improvements_en: Add alert notification functionality for excessive time deviations (email, push, sound)
Add an interface mechanism with trading EAs to automatically pass calibrated time to dependent EAs

risk_points: 如果时间同步失败未被发现，依赖此工具的交易EA可能使用错误的时间下单
网络延迟波动可能导致时间偏移计算不稳定
risk_points_en: If time synchronization failure goes unnoticed, dependent trading EAs may place orders with incorrect timestamps
Network latency fluctuations may cause unstable time offset calculations

summary_en: This EA is a time synchronization utility for the FORTS (Futures and Options on Russian Trading System) market. It synchronizes the local terminal time with the exchange server time to ensure accurate timing for time-sensitive trading operations on the Moscow Exchange derivatives segment.
